title: 所: the concept of place
summary: ところ is a place, and then a point in a thing or a point in time: ところだ means about to, in the middle of, or just done.

blocks.text: **ところ** (所) begins as a physical **place**: 私のところ, "my place". Japanese stretches the idea much further than English does.

blocks.jp: 私のところに遊びに来て。

blocks.text: A place in a thing: an aspect
A person or object has "places" too: the parts or points of it. Asking どこが好き? about a person means "which point do you like?".

lines.en: Which part of Sakura do you like?

blocks.jp: 分からないところがあった。
blocks.en: There were parts I did not understand.

blocks.text: A place in time: ところだ

Put a clause before ところ and you point at a **moment**. The sentence ends in だ, so it is an "A is B" sentence: "the present moment is the place of ...". The main carriage is a hidden zero, "it, the present moment", like "It's time to leave" in English. The tense of the clause chooses the point.
食べるところだ。 It is the moment of eating.

blocks.jp: 今から昼ご飯を食べるところだ。
blocks.en: I am just about to eat lunch.

blocks.jp: 今、昼ご飯を食べているところだ。
blocks.en: I am in the middle of eating lunch right now.

blocks.jp: 昼ご飯を食べたところだ。

blocks.text: Compare **ばかり** (lesson 27): 食べたばかり is close to 食べたところ. But ばかり can follow a plain noun (パンばかり) and ところ cannot, because "a place of bread" says nothing about amount.
In casual speech だ may vanish and ところ shortens to **とこ**: 今、着いたとこ. And context decides between meanings: いいところに来たね is probably "you came at a good moment".

items: **ところ** = place, a part of something, or a moment.
**Dictionary form + ところだ**: about to.
**〜ているところだ**: in the middle of.

questions.prompt: 今、出かけるところです。
options: I am just about to go out
questions.note: Dictionary form + ところ: about to.
questions.en: I am just about to go out.

questions.prompt: 今、お風呂に入っているところです。
options: I am in the middle of taking a bath
I am about to take a bath
I will take a bath tomorrow
questions.note: 〜ているところ: in the middle of.
questions.en: I am in the middle of taking a bath.

questions.prompt: さっき、家に着いたところです。
options: I am about to get home
I am on my way home
questions.note: Past + ところ: just did.
Dictionary form + ところ: about to.
questions.en: I am just about to arrive at the station.

questions.prompt: ちょうど手紙を書いている＿＿だ。
questions.note: 〜ているところ: in the middle of.
questions.en: I am in the middle of writing a letter.

questions.prompt: 今、起きた＿＿です。まだ眠いです。
questions.note: Past + ところ: just did.
questions.en: I just woke up. I am still sleepy.

questions.instruction: What does ところ mean here?
questions.prompt: この町のいいところは、静かなことです。
questions.note: A place in a thing: an aspect.
questions.en: The good point of this town is that it is quiet.

questions.instruction: What does ところ mean here?
questions.prompt: 分からないところは、先生に聞いてください。
questions.note: A part or point of something.
questions.en: Please ask the teacher about the parts you do not understand.

questions.instruction: Which sentence says "I have just finished my homework"?
options: 宿題が終わったところだ。
宿題をしているところだ。
宿題が終わるところだ。
questions.note: Past + ところだ: just did.

questions.prompt: With 〜ところ, a dictionary form means the action is already finished.
questions.note: It means about to do it.

options: 今、ご飯を作るところだ。
今、ご飯を作っているところだ。
ご飯を作ったところだ。
questions.note: The clause comes before ところ.

questions.instruction: Which clause form means "in the middle of" before ところ?
questions.note: 〜ているところ.

questions.instruction: What does ところ mean here?
questions.prompt: 私の家は、駅から近いところにある。
questions.note: ところ begins as a place.
questions.en: My house is in a place close to the station.

questions.instruction: What does ところ mean in あなたのところ?
questions.prompt: あなたのところに行ってもいいですか。
questions.note: 私のところ: my place.
questions.en: May I come to your place?

questions.prompt: I am in the middle of cooking dinner.
questions.note: 〜ているところです.
questions.en: I am in the middle of cooking dinner.

questions.prompt: I have just come back from the station.
questions.note: Past + ところです.
questions.en: I have just come back from the station.

questions.prompt: I am just about to go to bed.
questions.note: Dictionary form + ところです.
questions.en: I am just about to go to bed.

questions.prompt: The good point of this phone is the camera.
questions.note: ところ as a point of something.
questions.en: The good point of this phone is the camera.

questions.prompt: I was just about to call you.
questions.note: Dictionary form + ところだった.
questions.en: I was just about to call you.

questions.instruction: Tap the verb form that goes before ところ to say "just did"
questions.note: The past form + ところ.
questions.en: I have just read the email.

questions.instruction: Tap the verb form that goes before ところだ to say "in the middle of"
questions.note: 〜ているところ.
questions.en: We are in the middle of eating together.

questions.instruction: Tap the word where ところ means a "point" of something
questions.note: A place in a thing: an aspect.
questions.en: I like how big this car is.
